latHint: Think a velvety garden flower - not a string instrument.
pivHint: A VIOLA is a stringed instrument - but VIOLA is also a flower, a close cousin of the ______.
winText: In bloom. VIOLA was the pivot - a string instrument to a PANSY.
lossText: PANSY - a velvety garden flower. VIOLA was the pivot: a string VIOLA to the VIOLA flower.
